  WHY: The fragment will still be assembled by `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` because the path is unique, but the naming convention is broken. The convention exists so two concurrent PRs editing the same area pick distinct paths by issue/PR number; a run ID is not stable for that purpose and obscures provenance.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description states "the item stays open, gets one line in a single standing 'needs human' issue, and triggers one Telegram alert."

  Evidence of absence: The plan's P6 step 2 retries unconfirmed Telegram sends, and the Risks & Mitigations section explicitly states "an ambiguous Telegram response may have delivered even though the ledger records no confirmation, so retry can produce a second alert." The "one Telegram alert" promise in the PR description is therefore not literally deliverable; the plan acknowledges a second-alert case as an accepted trade-off. Either the PR description should reflect that reality (e.g., "at least one Telegram alert; a second may fire when the first response is ambiguous") or P6 should add a guard (idempotency token / dedupe marker checked before the retry send) so the at-most-once property actually holds.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
